name: moonraker-auth
title: Moonraker Login
description: Controls Moonraker's force_logins setting. When on, the web UI requires a login before any control; when off, local clients connect without logging in. Toggle the setting below before installing.
tagline: Require a login for the web UI, or allow open access.

config.label: Require login
config.hint: On: the web UI asks for a login before any control. Off: local clients connect without logging in.
